text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Hong Kong and Shanghai Bank Corp has moved to the Pudong New Area, the third foreign bank moving to Pudong for the local currency business after Citibank of the United States and Tokyo-Mishubishi Bank of Japan.

- An assessment of intangible assets of Chinese firms shows that listed companies have taken the lead with Shanghai-listed Sichuan Changhong Electric Co topping the listed on intangible assets of 12.208 billion yuan.
- More than 800 securities brokerage offices are now using the Shanghai stock exchange's remote computerised trading system five months after the system went live.

- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai Ouxing Company, a private high-tech firm, has acquired state-owned Shanghai Bench Clamp Plant in the first case of its kind in Shanghai's efforts to restructure the state sector.
- General manager of China's First Automobiles (Group) Co has urged re-organisation of China's auto industry by shutting scattered small plants.
